name: Melli Disk Usage
author: arsham

sections.description:
Melli Disk Usage is a powerful WordPress plugin that displays detailed information about your hosting, WordPress installation, and hosting API in a professional and user-friendly interface. It includes host details (disk space, memory usage, PHP version, etc.), WordPress statistics (plugins, users, posts, etc.), and additional metrics like cache status, SSL status, and server uptime. Perfect for website administrators and developers to monitor site performance and resources.

Short Description

Melli Disk Usage is a powerful plugin that displays detailed hosting, WordPress, and API information with a professional interface. Ideal for monitoring site performance and resources.

Support

For support, please visit our website at https://me-services.ir or contact us directly through WordPress.org forums.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the melli-disk-usage folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the “Melli Disk Usage” menu in the WordPress admin panel to view detailed information.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a hosting API?

Some features, like bandwidth usage and traffic statistics, require integration with your hosting provider’s API. Basic functionality works without it.

Can I translate the plugin into other languages?

Yes, the plugin uses WordPress translation functions and includes an English translation file (melli-disk-usage-en_US.po). You can create additional translations using Poedit or similar tools.

Is this plugin compatible with older WordPress versions?

Yes, it requires WordPress 5.0 or higher and PHP 7.0 or higher, making it compatible with most WordPress installations.
sections.changelog:
4.0

  • Updated plugin version to 4.0 for release preparation.

3.1

  • Updated “Requires PHP” to 7.0 to meet minimum WordPress.org requirements.
  • Removed unnecessary load_plugin_textdomain() function for WordPress 4.6+ compatibility.
  • Fixed internationalization issues by using static strings and ordered placeholders.
  • Added sanitization and escaping for data security.
  • Removed invalid tags “plugin” and “wordpress” from readme.txt.

3.0

  • Added new features: Cache Status, SSL Status, Firewall Status, MySQL Version, Database Size, Bandwidth Usage, Traffic Statistics, Server Uptime, Number of Updates Available, Theme Information, File Permissions Status, Cron Jobs Status, and Error Logs Summary.
  • Updated minimum WordPress version to 5.0 and PHP to 5.6 for broader compatibility.
  • Ensured English-only language files.
  • Maintained the current professional design with white cards and green status boxes.

2.0

  • Initial release with host and WordPress information, API hosting details, and a modern UI.
